summary: Per-frame vehicle physics update: copies and adjusts the four wheel contact-patch positions, recomputes weight distribution from the car-setup block (a2), rebuilds per-wheel suspension/tire state (temperatures, loads, spring/damper split), computes anti-roll bar mixing and drivetrain/mass parameters, runs a 13-point contact-position transform (with per-point bitmask-driven tweaks and a bounding-radius tracking), evaluates six polynomial/tire-force helper models, sums the resulting force vector, applies session (a3) offsets to the tracked contact points, fills a 13-point particle buffer, writes the wheel output positions, and returns an advanced pointer into the session block. Reads configuration from a2 (car setup) and a3 (session/track state); writes results back into the vehicle struct (this).
